citations.quote: Two ways Dubai prop-tech startup ends in 2026.

situation.text: Olga_Si_Sales describes two potential endings for a Dubai prop-tech startup in 2026, focusing on B2B and B2C models.

cases.title: Two potential futures for a startup

citations.quote:
For B2B: you get two or three companies paying you for two, three months. Then the guy inside who had your back leaves. The next one has no budget at all. No case studies, no sales process, no product. You can stay in that cycle for years.

For B2C: a lot of free users who open it twice, maybe some💰 for a month, then cancel. No profit.

observation.text: The post is structured as a comparison between two scenarios—one for B2B startups and one for B2C startups. Each scenario describes a negative outcome without suggesting solutions.
The author ends the post with a prompting question, inviting readers to share their thoughts.
